historical_result.post_navigation_snapshot: BrowserTool returned success with an embedded destroyed-execution-context error. This observation failure is separate from the subsequent click timeout and is not treated as proof that navigation failed.

fixed_candidate_control.revised_candidate: The revised complete-order-grid retrieval passed the official programmatic rule and was independently checked against source order rows.

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 历史 Moli 1.1.3 在第 6 步点击可见的 Clear all 超时。用正式评测相同的镜像在当前远端站点重放原动作，60 秒后订单网格已在 DOM、页面加载完成，两枚 Clear all 按钮及父容器却全为零矩形，offsetParent 为 null；订单 230 链接也为零矩形。可见性筛选因此无法选中按钮。固定构建原样完成 9/9 步。这是旧版订单网格的布局几何故障，不是 Clear all 按钮缺失；导航后的快照错误是另一项观察失败，不能单独解释持续零几何。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: Historical Moli 1.1.3 timed out at action 6 waiting for a visible Clear all button. Replaying the original actions on the same image as the formal evaluation against the current remote site, the order grid was in the DOM and the document was complete after 60 seconds, yet both Clear all buttons and their parents had zero rectangles and null offsetParent; the order 230 link also had zero geometry. Visibility matching therefore could not select the button. The fixed build completed the original 9/9 actions. This is an old-version order-grid geometry defect, not an absent button. The post-navigation snapshot error is a separate observation failure and does not alone explain persistent zero geometry.

scope_limit: The same formal Moli image reproduces the observable defect and the fixed build completes the original actions, but this site test does not bisect dirty-layout versus root-relative-unit contributions or replace the immutable historical score.
